title: Chang'an's Lychees
summary_en: A historical novel depicting the journey of transporting fresh lychees to the capital during the Tang dynasty, reflecting politics, power, and human fate.
summary_zh: 一部以唐代荔枝进贡为背景的历史小说，展现了政治博弈、人性命运与权力角逐。
best_quote_en: A lychee from Lingnan may decide the fate of the entire empire.
best_quote_zh: 岭南一颗荔枝，关乎天下之势。

title: The Three-Body Problem
summary_en: A sci-fi classic exploring first contact between humanity and an alien civilization from a three-sun system.
summary_zh: 描写地球文明与三体文明第一次接触的科幻经典，探讨人类的未来与文明的冲突。
best_quote_en: Weakness and ignorance are not barriers to survival, arrogance is.
best_quote_zh: 弱小和无知不是生存的障碍，傲慢才是。

title: Records of the Ming Dynasty
summary_en: A popular history book that retells the Ming dynasty's events in a witty and accessible style.
summary_zh: 以生动幽默的语言讲述明朝历史，让历史变得有趣又容易理解。
best_quote_en: History is not only about emperors and generals, but also about ordinary people's joys and sorrows.
best_quote_zh: 历史不仅是帝王将相的故事，也是百姓悲欢的记录。

title: To Live
summary_en: A story of an ordinary man enduring hardships and tragedies, yet choosing to live on.
summary_zh: 讲述一个普通人在苦难与悲剧中仍然选择活下去的故事。
best_quote_en: To live is to bear the suffering of life with patience and dignity.
best_quote_zh: 活着，就是忍受生命赋予我们的苦难。

title: Ordinary World
summary_en: A realist novel reflecting the lives, struggles, and dreams of ordinary people in China's reform era.
summary_zh: 一部现实主义作品，描写改革年代普通人的生活、奋斗与理想。
best_quote_en: Even in the most ordinary life, there is a shining strength.
best_quote_zh: 即使是平凡的生活，也有闪光的力量。

title: Awakening of Cognition
summary_en: A book on how to improve cognition, optimize habits, and achieve personal growth.
summary_zh: 一本探讨如何提升认知、优化习惯，实现自我成长的作品。
best_quote_en: Cognition determines destiny; the higher your perspective, the farther you can go.
best_quote_zh: 认知决定命运，站得越高，看得越远。

title: The Little Prince
source: 安托万·德·圣-埃克苏佩里
summary_en: A poetic fable about a young prince exploring the universe and discovering love, loneliness, and meaning.
summary_zh: 一部诗意的寓言，讲述小王子探索宇宙，发现爱、孤独与意义的故事。
best_quote_en: What is essential is invisible to the eye.
best_quote_zh: 真正重要的东西，用眼睛是看不见的。

title: Destiny
summary_en: A novel that weaves family stories and fate, reflecting the struggles of ordinary people.
summary_zh: 一部交织家庭故事与命运的小说，展现普通人的挣扎与生命张力。
best_quote_en: Fate is like the tide, sometimes pushing us forward, sometimes pulling us back.
best_quote_zh: 命运如潮，有时推着我们前进，有时把我们拉回。

title: One Sentence Worth Ten Thousand
summary_en: A novel about the difficulty of communication and the loneliness of individuals in modern society.
summary_zh: 一部描写沟通困境与现代人孤独的小说。
best_quote_en: People talk endlessly, but only one sentence truly hits the heart.
best_quote_zh: 人们说了一万句废话，可能只有一句说到心里。

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
source: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯
summary_en: A masterpiece of magical realism, narrating the rise and fall of the Buendía family over a century.
summary_zh: 魔幻现实主义经典，讲述布恩迪亚家族百年的兴衰史。
best_quote_en: Many years later, as he faced the firing squad, Colonel Aureliano Buendía was to remember that distant afternoon when his father took him to discover ice.
best_quote_zh: 多年以后，奥雷连诺上校站在行刑队面前，必将想起父亲带他去见识冰块的那个遥远的下午。

title: 字节Seed发布PXDesign：蛋白设计效率提升十倍，进入实用新阶段
title_zh: 字节Seed发布PXDesign：蛋白设计效率提升十倍，进入实用新阶段
summary_en: ByteDance's Seed team has made a significant breakthrough in AI-driven protein design with PXDesign, achieving a 10x efficiency improvement over existing methods. This system can generate hundreds of high-quality candidate proteins within 24 hours, with wet lab success rates of 20-73% across multiple targets, substantially outperforming DeepMind's AlphaProteo (9-33%). What makes this particularly compelling is the combination of two technical approaches - diffusion-based PXDesign-d and hallucination-based PXDesign-h - with the diffusion method showing superior performance in quality, throughput, and structural diversity. The team's innovation extends beyond algorithm development to practical application through their free web service PXDesign Server and standardized evaluation toolkit PXDesignBench. This democratization of advanced protein design tools could accelerate therapeutic development for cancer and infectious diseases, representing a meaningful shift from academic research to industrial application. The timing is noteworthy given the 2024 Nobel Prize recognition for computational protein design, suggesting this field is reaching a maturity inflection point.
summary_zh: 字节Seed团队推出的PXDesign标志着AI蛋白设计进入实用化新阶段。该系统不仅将设计效率提升十倍，更在多个靶点上实现20-73%的实验成功率，远超DeepMind同类方案。更值得关注的是团队通过免费网页服务和开源评估工具，将高端蛋白设计能力民主化，让普通科研人员也能便捷使用。这不仅是技术突破，更是科研范式的转变——从依赖昂贵高通量筛选转向精准AI设计。考虑到2024年诺贝尔化学奖授予蛋白设计领域，这一进展可能开启生物医药研发的新时代。
best_quote_en: The breakthrough means scientists no longer need to rely on expensive high-throughput screening experiments, but can directly obtain binders that tightly grasp target proteins using only low-throughput conventional experiments.
best_quote_zh: 这意味着，科学家们不用再像过去那样依赖昂贵的高通量筛选实验，只需要低通量的常规实验，就能直接得到能紧紧抓住目标蛋白的binder。

title: Introducing RTEB: A New Standard for Retrieval Evaluation
title_zh: 介绍RTEB：检索评估的新标准
summary_en: RTEB represents a significant advancement in AI evaluation methodology, addressing the critical gap between academic benchmarks and real-world performance. The hybrid approach combining open and private datasets cleverly tackles the 'teaching to the test' problem that plagues current evaluation standards. By maintaining transparency through public datasets while preserving the integrity of generalization testing with private ones, RTEB creates a more honest assessment environment. What particularly resonates is the emphasis on enterprise domains—legal, healthcare, finance, and multilingual scenarios—reflecting the actual environments where retrieval models must perform. The performance discrepancies already observed between open and private datasets validate the need for this approach. However, the admission that 50% of datasets are repurposed from QA sources raises valid concerns about whether this fundamentally addresses the semantic understanding challenge or merely creates a more sophisticated testing environment. The community-driven development model suggests this could evolve into a truly robust standard, though its success will depend on widespread adoption and continuous dataset refinement.
summary_zh: RTEB基准测试的推出标志着AI评估方法的重要突破。其混合策略巧妙解决了当前基准测试中'应试教育'的弊端——公开数据集保证透明度，私有数据集测试真实泛化能力。特别值得关注的是其对法律、医疗、金融等企业级场景的覆盖，以及20种语言的支持，这恰恰是真实应用场景的映射。不过，50%数据集来自问答重用的设计，让人不禁思考这究竟是真正解决了语义理解问题，还是仅仅构建了更复杂的测试环境。这种社区驱动的模式能否成为行业标准，关键在于能否持续优化数据集并获得广泛认可。
best_quote_en: When models are repeatedly evaluated against the same public datasets, a gap emerges between their reported scores and their actual performance on new, unseen data.
best_quote_zh: 当模型反复在相同的公共数据集上评估时，其报告分数与在新未见数据上的实际性能之间就会出现差距。

title: 恒指午盘涨1.45%，恒生科技指数大涨2.66%
title_zh: 恒指午盘涨1.45%，恒生科技指数大涨2.66%
summary_en: This market update from October 2, 2025, reveals significant midday gains in Hong Kong's key stock indices, with the Hang Seng Index rising 1.45% and the Hang Seng Tech Index surging 2.66%. The standout performers include semiconductor giants like SMIC, which jumped 9.30%, and Hua Hong Semiconductor, up 5.44%, suggesting robust investor confidence in the tech hardware sector. EV maker Nio also saw a solid 4.53% increase, while Tencent Holdings advanced 2.34%. However, not all stocks shared in the rally—Trip.com Group and Tencent Music declined by over 2%, indicating selective profit-taking or sector-specific concerns. With a substantial half-day turnover of HK$123.98 billion, the data points to heightened trading activity, possibly driven by macroeconomic optimism or tech sector breakthroughs. As an analyst, I find the divergence between tech hardware and consumer internet stocks particularly intriguing; it may reflect shifting global supply chain dynamics or anticipation of policy support. This snapshot offers a real-time pulse on Asian markets, but its deeper value lies in prompting questions about sustainability—are these gains backed by fundamental improvements or merely short-term sentiment?
summary_zh: 这篇2025年10月2日的午盘快讯显示香港股市显著走强，恒生指数涨1.45%，恒生科技指数更是飙升2.66%。中芯国际和华虹半导体分别大涨9.30%和5.44%，凸显科技硬件板块的强劲势头，而蔚来和腾讯也录得可观涨幅。不过，携程和腾讯音乐的下跌提醒我们市场分化依然存在。半日成交额达1239.80亿港元，表明交投活跃。在我看来，这不仅是数字的波动，更折射出投资者对科技创新和宏观经济预期的微妙变化——硬件股的领跑或许预示着供应链重构的加速，但能否持续还需观察基本面的支撑。
best_quote_en: SMIC rose 9.30%, Hua Hong Semiconductor rose 5.44%, and Nio-SW rose 4.53%.
best_quote_zh: 中芯国际涨9.30%，华虹半导体涨5.44%，蔚来-SW涨4.53%。

title: Automakers charged with keeping EV sales going
title_zh: 汽车制造商承担起维持电动汽车销售势头的重任
summary_en: This analysis reveals a fascinating paradox in the electric vehicle market: while recent sales data shows impressive growth—with Cox Automotive reporting a 21.1% year-over-year increase and JD Power noting EVs captured 11% of the US market in August—this success appears artificially inflated by the impending expiration of federal tax credits. The situation mirrors a classic behavioral economics scenario where temporary incentives create short-term demand surges followed by predictable slumps. What intrigues me most is the strategic divergence among automakers: Ford's CEO Jim Farley openly anticipates market share dropping to 5% and champions hybrids as the true electric future, while Tesla, GM, and Hyundai develop creative financing workarounds to maintain momentum. This isn't merely about sales figures—it's a real-time experiment in how industries transition between government-supported adoption and organic market demand. The hybrid versus pure EV debate Farley raises suggests we might be witnessing a fundamental recalibration of what 'electric future' actually means in practice.
summary_zh: 电动汽车市场正经历政策刺激后的宿醉期——税收抵免结束前的销售狂欢与之后的预期回落形成了鲜明对比。最值得深思的是福特CEO法利直言电动车份额将跌至5%并看好混动技术，这揭示了行业对电动化路径的深刻分歧。当特斯拉等企业自掏腰包维持补贴时，我们看到的不仅是市场策略差异，更是整个产业对电动化转型节奏的不同判断。这种政策依赖与市场真实的拉锯战，或许将重新定义未来十年的汽车能源格局。
best_quote_en: He also said that he foresees hybrids as the electric future.
best_quote_zh: 他还表示，他预见混合动力车将成为电动化的未来。

title: Barry Diller: Building IAC
source: Farnam Street (FS Blog, Thinking & Growth, English)
summary_en: Barry Diller's profound reflections at 83 reveal a lifetime of counterintuitive business wisdom that challenges modern corporate orthodoxy. His philosophy of 'trust first' represents a radical departure from today's risk-averse culture, suggesting that the speed gained through trust outweighs the occasional betrayal. The most compelling insight is his assertion that 'success teaches you nothing' while failure is essential—a humbling perspective from someone who built media empires. His preference for instinct over algorithms in our data-obsessed world feels particularly courageous, reminding us that while data reveals patterns of the past, true innovation requires human intuition. The emphasis on embracing conflict rather than seeking consensus reveals a nuanced understanding that friction often produces the most valuable insights. What makes Diller's wisdom so enduring is how these principles form an integrated system: starting with trust enables faster decision-making, while being prepared to walk away provides the backbone to make those decisions confidently. This isn't just business advice—it's a philosophy for meaningful work and life.
summary_zh: 83岁的巴里·迪勒展现了一种反直觉的商业智慧：成功毫无教益，失败才是必修课。他提出的'信任先行'原则在当今风险规避文化中显得尤为激进，认为信任带来的速度优势远超偶尔背叛的代价。在数据至上的时代，他坚持直觉胜过算法，提醒我们数据只能揭示过去模式，真正的创新需要人类直觉。拥抱冲突而非追求共识的哲学，揭示了摩擦往往产生最有价值的洞见。这些原则构成了一个完整体系——以信任为起点加速决策，以随时离开的底气支撑决策信心。这不仅关乎商业，更关乎有意义的工作与人生。
best_quote_en: "Data can tell you what has happened, not what can or will happen."
best_quote_zh: “数据只能告诉你已经发生了什么，而不是可能或将要发生什么。”
